[EN] Poison Mushrooms
[ES] Hongos venenosos
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Please kill the {@Creature:47#1003#argon mugatos} that interrupt our work, and join us in removing petrified mushrooms.
[ES] Por favor, mata a los {@Creature:47#1003#mugatos de argón} que interrumpen nuestro trabajo y ayúdanos a deshacernos de los hongos petrificados.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] They explode quite nicely, don't they?
[ES] Explotan bastante bien, ¿verdad?
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] While killing {@creature:47#1003#argon mugatos} in the {@Rgn:47003$$Bridgehead}, use bombs or weapons to break {@creature:47#7004#spore emitters}.
[ES] Mientras matas a los {@creature:47#1003#mugatos de argón} en la {@Rgn:47003$$Cabeza de puente}, usa bombas o armas para destruir los {@creature:47#7004#emisores de esporas}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Thanks.
[ES] Gracias.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to {@Rgn:47008$$Eastwatch} and report to {@creature:247#1018$$Lenon Timbus}.
[ES] Ve a {@Rgn:47008$$Atalaya del Este} e infórmale a {@creature:247#1018$$Lenon Timbus}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
